nodes.description: Ownable.owner, the privileged owner address set to msg.sender in constructor.
BaseWallet._owner, wallet owner slot set via initOwner/setOwner.
ReentrancyGuard._guardValue, reentrancy lock toggled by nonReentrant.
BaseWallet.modules mapping(address=>bool) of enabled wallet modules.
BaseWallet.controller, Controller instance reference.
BaseWallet.methodToModule mapping of 4-byte selector to module address.
MetaTxAware.trustedForwarder, address allowed to relay meta transactions.
AddressSet.sets mapping(bytes32=>Set) holding address sets.
NonceStore.nonces mapping(address=>uint) of last used nonce.
HashStore.hashes mapping of consumed request hashes.
QuotaStore.quotas mapping(address=>Quota) of spending quotas.
SecurityStore.wallets mapping(address=>Wallet) guardian/lock state.
WhitelistStore.effectiveTimeMap of wallet/addr to effective time.
QuotaStore.defaultQuota fallback daily quota value.
WalletFactory.blanks mapping of pre-deployed blank proxies to module versions.
WalletFactory.walletImplementation address used as proxy implementation.
Ownable.transferOwnership/Claimable.transferOwnership, onlyOwner ownership transfer.
Claimable.claimOwnership, finalizes a pending ownership transfer.
BaseWallet.transact, module-initiated generic call/delegatecall entry point.
BaseWallet.nonReentrantCall, private low-level call/delegatecall/staticcall with reentrancy guard.
BaseWallet.fallback, dispatches msg.data to the bound module.
AddressUtil.sendETH, forwards ETH with caller-supplied gas limit via call.
AddressUtil.fastCall, assembly low-level call with in-memory data.
BaseWallet.addModule, external module addition entry point.
BaseWallet.removeModule, deactivates and deletes a module.
BaseWallet.setOwner, module-only owner change.
BaseWallet.initOwner, factory-only initialization of wallet owner.
BaseWallet.initController, one-time controller initialization.
WalletFactory.createWallet, deploys and initializes a new wallet from a signed request.
WalletFactory.createWallet2, consumes a blank proxy to create a wallet.
WalletFactory.deploy_, CREATE2 deploy of SimpleProxy and wallet init.
WalletFactory.registerENS_, registers ENS and optional reverse record.
BaseENSManager.verifyApproval, recovers signer of ENS approval.
DappAddressStore.addDapp, manager-only dapp whitelisting.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate, wallet-module-only hash consumption.
NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate, wallet-module-only nonce validation/update.
QuotaStore.changeQuota, schedules a new quota with effective time.
QuotaStore.addToSpent, adds an amount to the rolling spent quota.
QuotaStore.spentQuota, computes decayed spent quota from block.timestamp.
SecurityStore.addGuardian, wallet-module-only guardian addition.
SecurityStore.removeGuardian, sets validUntil on a guardian.
SecurityStore.setLock, wallet-module-only lock setting.
SecurityStore.touchLastActive, updates lastActive timestamp.
WhitelistStore.addToWhitelist, adds address with effective time.
QuotaStore.changeDefaultQuota, owner-only default quota change.
MetaTxAware.msgSender, derives logical sender from msg.data when called by trusted forwarder.
AddressSet.addAddressToSet, pushes an address and increments count.
AddressSet.removeAddressFromSet, swap-removes an address and decrements count.
MathUint.mul, checked multiplication.
MathUint.sub, checked subtraction.
MathUint.add, checked addition.
SignatureUtil.verifySignature, dispatches EOA or ERC1271 verification.
SignatureUtil.recoverECDSASigner, ecrecover with malleability check.
SimpleProxy.setImplementation, writes implementation pointer via assembly sstore.
Proxy.fallback, delegatecalls the implementation.
OwnerManagable.addManager/addManagerInternal, owner-only manager addition.
BaseENSManager.register, manager-only subdomain registration.
WalletFactory.validateRequest_, verifies the signed wallet creation request.
WalletFactory.initializeWallet_, initializes owner, registry and ENS.
SignatureUtil.verifyERC1271Signature, staticcall to signer contract.
SignatureUtil.verifyEOASignature, EIP712/ETH_SIGN ECDSA verification.
BaseWallet.addModuleInternal, validates and records a module then activates it.
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller used in authorization checks.
block.timestamp, miner-influenced time used for locks, quotas and whitelisting.

newOwner parameter of Claimable.transferOwnership.

edges.reason: BaseWallet.transact routes to an external CALL on an arbitrary target before finalizing state.
BaseWallet.transact can issue a DELEGATECALL into an arbitrary target.
BaseWallet.transact can issue a STATICCALL into an arbitrary target.
nonReentrantCall performs a low-level call to target.
nonReentrantCall performs a low-level delegatecall to target.
nonReentrantCall performs a low-level staticcall to target.
sendETH forwards ETH through call with a caller-supplied gas limit.
fastCall executes an assembly call to an arbitrary address.
ERC1271 verification staticcalls an untrusted signer contract.
Proxy fallback delegatecalls the stored implementation.
_guardValue is set and cleared around nonReentrantCall to block reentrancy.
transact relies on the nonReentrantCall guard for external interactions.
MathUint.mul computes a*b and checks for overflow.
MathUint.sub computes a-b guarded by an underflow require.
MathUint.add computes a+b and checks for overflow.
addAddressToSet increments set.count unchecked against overflow.
removeAddressFromSet decrements set.count after deletion.
spentQuota computes decay arithmetic over spentAmount.
transferOwnership is authorized by msg.sender equalling owner.
setOwner is restricted to registered modules via msg.sender.
addModule authorization checks msg.sender against factory or modules.
removeModule is restricted via onlyFromModule using msg.sender.
HashStore.verifyAndUpdate is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
NonceStore.verifyAndUpdate is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
addToWhitelist is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
setLock is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
touchLastActive is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
msgSender derives a logical sender from msg.data when msg.sender is the trusted forwarder.
setImplementation is only guarded by an address(0) check, any caller may front-run initialization.
addManager is gated by onlyOwner over msg.sender.
addDapp is gated by onlyManager over msg.sender.
addGuardian is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
removeGuardian is gated by onlyWalletModule(msg.sender).
transact is restricted by onlyFromFactoryOrModule checking msg.sender.
spentQuota decay depends on block.timestamp.
addToWhitelist uses block.timestamp to clamp effective time.
touchLastActive stores block.timestamp as lastActive.
setLock compares the lock value against block.timestamp.
changeQuota evaluates pending quota against block.timestamp.

createWallet initializes the freshly deployed wallet.
createWallet2 validates the signed creation request.
createWallet2 initializes the wallet after consuming a blank.
initializeWallet_ calls initOwner on the new wallet.
initializeWallet_ triggers ENS registration when a label is provided.

registerENS_ calls ensManager.register.

verifyApproval recovers the ECDSA signer from the approval.
verifySignature recovers an ECDSA signer for EOA accounts.
verifySignature dispatches to ERC1271 for contract signers.
verifySignature dispatches to EOA signature verification.
addManagerInternal adds the manager to the managers address set.
addModule calls addModuleInternal.
addModuleInternal records the module in the modules mapping.
setOwner writes the _owner state variable.
initOwner writes the _owner state variable.
initController writes the controller reference.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
claimOwnership finalizes owner from pendingOwner.
verifyAndUpdate marks the request hash consumed.
verifyAndUpdate stores the accepted nonce.
changeQuota updates the wallet quota struct.
addToSpent updates spentAmount and spentTimestamp.
spentQuota reads the wallet quota struct.
addGuardian updates the wallet guardian array.
removeGuardian updates the wallet guardian validUntil.
setLock updates the wallet lock fields.
touchLastActive updates the wallet lastActive timestamp.
addToWhitelist writes the effective time mapping.
changeDefaultQuota updates the defaultQuota value.
addAddressToSet mutates the sets storage mapping.
removeAddressFromSet mutates the sets storage mapping.
msgSender compares msg.sender against trustedForwarder.
deploy_ uses Create2 to deploy the SimpleProxy instance.
deploy_ configures the proxy implementation from walletImplementation.
setImplementation stores the implementation address used by the factory.
transact target address flows into the low-level call.
transact value flows into the low-level call.
transact calldata flows into the low-level call.
mode parameter selects which low-level call nonReentrantCall performs.
owner signature parameter is consumed by validateRequest_.
owner parameter drives createWallet request validation.
salt parameter drives createWallet request validation.
module parameter is added by addModule.
addr parameter is inserted by addAddressToSet.
key parameter selects the set mutated by addAddressToSet.
Set storage local is manipulated by addAddressToSet.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter has no independent semantics outside the ownership-transfer function that consumes it.
The Claimable newOwner parameter only exists to be written by the ownership-transfer function.
The module address parameter is only meaningful as the argument of addModule.
The mode parameter only selects the call type inside nonReentrantCall.
The target address parameter is the destination of the low-level call operation.
The value parameter is the ETH amount forwarded by the low-level call operation.
The data parameter is the calldata payload of the low-level call operation.
The owner parameter is only used to build and validate the wallet creation request.
The salt parameter is only used for CREATE2 address derivation in createWallet.
The signature parameter is consumed exclusively by the request validation logic.
The addr parameter is the address being inserted into the set.
The key parameter selects which set is mutated by addAddressToSet.
The Set storage local is a transient handle to the set mutated by addAddressToSet.
The pos local is a transient index used to swap-remove in removeAddressFromSet.
The wallet parameter keys the whitelist mapping written by addToWhitelist.
The amount parameter is the value added to the spent quota in addToSpent.
The success local is a transient result flag inside transact.
